result:
Round 407 passes. I found no bugs, and `c-round-407.json` has `browserVerified` and `realVerified` set to true.

I ran every row in the real browser (Playwright Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720) or against the source tree. The full test suite, typecheck, build, Biome and `verify` were not run: they belong to the root gate, and `gates/gate-round-407.json` was not available to me.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| Source scope, start and end | Pass. The working tree holds exactly the 4 granted paths, and the claims at the end equal the claims at the start. |
| Patch identity | Pass. The patch applied to a fresh copy of HEAD matches the working tree in both files. |
| Stopped seek | Pass. All 4 steps (ruler click, move release, Undo, Redo) have error 0 at both viewports. The first 1440 run timed out on the cold server (environment), and the retry passed. |
| Video sync during play | Pass. All 12 samples were playing, with max drift 0.008 s at 1440 and 0.013 s at 1280. The dock counters show 0 swaps and 0 fallbacks, and the caption reads "1.mp4". |
| Leaf render counts | Pass. There are no differences from B's sketch file. The video dock renders `[0,3,1,1,1,0,1,1,1,1,1,1,2]`, and the caption and the new inner box stay at 0 across all 13 steps. I saw 0 page errors. Clicking expand takes the inner box from 0 to 1. |
| Unit tests and mutants | Pass. The 16 covering files pass 360/360. On a committed scratch copy, all 7 mutants fail on their expected test row, and the runs before and after with no mutant pass. |
| Auth | Pass. `/studio-lab` opens with `auth_user` null and no sign-in wall. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio sources. `/api/studio-token` without auth returns 401. |
| Docs | Pass. Doc 260 line 4 is byte-exact, and its mutant rows match B's summary. Doc 259 differs from HEAD only on line 4. |

The path that sends a fake bearer token to `/api/studio-token` is blocked because the backend is unavailable in the cloud. I did not count it as passed.

Dragging the floating video box is covered only by unit tests in the 360 set. I did not run it in the browser.

A's three reviewer Lows (mutable registry inside `useMemo`, caption naming, a ref written during render) are not bugs. The patch was applied byte-for-byte, so they are for B to rule on.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-407.json`
- `c-round-407.md`
- `c-round-407/`
